stories.headline: OpenAI plans to cut Cursor model access
stories.summary: OpenAI plans to stop supplying models to SpaceX-owned Cursor, citing uncertainty over compliance with its terms. Cursor says talks continue; Anthropic plans more Claude capacity. The proposed cutoff is November 12.

stories.headline: Bessent faces G20 test on trade, Iran and debt
stories.summary: At the U.S.-hosted G20 finance meeting, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent will press trade, growth and Iran priorities while allies question tariffs and rising U.S. debt. Consensus is uncertain.

stories.headline: Kyiv-region strike toll rises to 38
stories.summary: President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said 38 people died and four remain missing after a Russian strike triggered explosions at a military ammunition facility. Cleanup and contamination work continue.

stories.headline: Thousands missing after Himalayan disaster
stories.summary: At least 750 people are reported dead and more than 3,000 missing after a glacier collapse and mudslide along the Nepal-China border. Bad weather and unstable terrain are impeding rescues; totals remain fluid.

stories.headline: US oil-equity report meets Pentagon denial
stories.summary: The Wall Street Journal reported a planned 35% U.S. stake in a Venezuelan oil venture. A Pentagon spokesperson said the relevant office does not take equity, leaving the reported structure unresolved.
